stratagem.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR
stratagem.lore: Booming war cries through his vox-amplifiers, this Dreadnought rampages through the terrified foe.
stratagem.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

stratagem.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
stratagem.lore: Once a foe is marked for destruction, the Angels of Death must not relent until the target is annihilated.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ [lethal hits]. ▪ Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagem.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
stratagem.lore: Ruins, barricades, bunkers; few such structures can impede the relentless advance of an Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought.
stratagem.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
